title: Amazon Order Burst Before Pantry Stockouts
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:order
| search stockout_risk_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as orders avg(stockout_risk_pct) as avg_stockout_risk_pct by _time category
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Amazon orders before pantry stockouts over time and breaks it out by category.
value: Order bursts before stockouts show where buying is happening reactively instead of from a stable household plan.
implementation: Send Amazon orders before pantry stockouts events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Amazon orders before pantry stockouts by category.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how Amazon orders before pantry stockouts changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
